title: MapleStory Classic Best Grind Maps by Level
original_title: Best Grind Maps for Every Level 1-50
author: Nia Meow
summary: A level-bracket training reference for levels 1-50, ranking candidate maps by theoretical EXP per hour and identifying the dominant monsters and party considerations.

sections.title: Level brackets
items: Compare the strongest candidates for each five-level bracket.
Keep the dominant monster close enough to the character level for efficient kills.

sections.title: Route highlights
items: Ant Tunnel is a central option through much of the 20s.
Kerning Subway becomes a major route from the 30s onward.

sections.title: Practical adjustment
items: Treat theoretical EXP per hour as a ceiling, then adjust for class reach and kill speed.
Party Quest and party bonuses can outperform solo grinding in the right group.

notes: Structured MPStorys reading edition verified in Chrome on 2026-07-27.
steps: Compare map ceilings and monster levels.
Test actual kill speed and travel time.
Re-evaluate after each major skill or equipment upgrade.
